name: Hosted Agents — static gateway
summary: Self-provisioned Hosted Agent (code-deployed via remote_build) whose container code BYOM-routes through the static APIM gateway.
description: Deploys a tiny Invocations-protocol agent from inline source (~40 LOC main.py) using `project.beta.agents.create_version_from_code` with `dependency_resolution=remote_build`. No ACR needed — Foundry builds the container. The agent reads the AI Gateway connection + model from custom env vars (`AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION`, `CHAT_MODEL`) plus the platform-injected `FOUNDRY_PROJECT_ENDPOINT`, then calls `responses.create(model=f'{conn}/{model}', ...)` from inside the container. Marker: `slow` — cold-start build is 2–5 min, so this test is opt-in via `pytest -m slow`.
notes: Requires `azure-ai-projects>=2.2.0` (uses the `beta` client surface for code deployment). Runtime: `python_3_13`. Cleans up the version in a finally block. Skips if `AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_STATIC` is unset.
